{{1958 Nebraska College Conference football standings}}
The '''1958 Kearney State Antelopes football team''' was an [[American football]] team that represented Kearney State College (later renamed [[University of Nebraska at Kearney]]) as a member of the [[Nebraska College Conference]] (NCC) during the [[1958 NAIA football season]]. In their fourth season under head coach [[Allen H. Zikmund]], the Antelopes compiled a perfect 9–0 record (7–0 against NCC opponents), tied with Chadron State for the NCC championship, and outscored opponents by a total of 389 to 42.<ref>{{cite web|title=Nebraska-Kearney Yearly Results|publisher=[[College Football Data Warehouse]]|accessdate=May 13, 2023|url=http://www.cfbdatawarehouse.com/data/active/n/nebraska_kearney/1955-1959_yearly_results.php|archive-date=September 6, 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150906203232/http://www.cfbdatawarehouse.com/data/active/n/nebraska_kearney/1955-1959_yearly_results.php|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Thanks Team|newspaper=The Antelope|date=November 14, 1958|page=2|url=https://www.newspapers.com/article/the-antelope-thanks-team/124659515/|via=[[Newspapers.com]]}}</ref> They ranked eighth in the final NAIA poll.<ref>{{cite news|title=Kearney, Chadron Listed: Antelopes 8th, Eagles 16th|newspaper=The Lincoln Star|date=November 12, 1958|page=13|url=https://www.newspapers.com/article/the-lincoln-star-kearney-chadron-listed/124661848/|via=[[Newspapers.com]]}}</ref>

The 1958 season was one of four [[perfect season]]s in the history of the Kearney football program, along with the [[1941 Kearney State Antelopes football team|1941]], [[1956 Kearney State Antelopes football team|1956]], and [[1967 Kearney State Antelopes football team|1967 seasons]].
